newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Citrus output for 1996/97 fell to 1.19 million tonnes from 1.4 million tonnes the previous season as result of heavy rains early this year which damaged crops followed by drought in April.
- Flotation of the 205,064 shares worth $8.63 million of credit firm Maghrebail oversubscribed 18 times.
- World Bank report on Morocco's infrastructure deplores state of ports and says private sector should contribute to improving them.
- Telecommunications utility inceases profit to 700 million dirhams ($73.6 million) in 1996, up 33 percent from the previous year.
